records.text: The Cattle Baron's Ball in Dallas is a single-night fundraiser for the American Cancer Society, is the world's largest single-night fundraiser, and was founded 50 years ago.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It's a single night fundraiser for the American Cancer Society. And it's massive. To be clear, it's the world's largest single night fundraiser. It was founded 50 years ago. in Dallas, Texas.

verification.notes: The Dallas Cattle Baron's Ball's official site confirms it began in 1974, benefits the American Cancer Society, and describes itself as the world's largest single-night fundraiser for the society. 'Founded 50 years ago' is a reasonable rounded description in the January 2026 source context.

sources.title: Cattle Baron's Ball Dallas — Official Site
sources.relevance: Confirms 1974 origin, American Cancer Society beneficiary, and largest single-night fundraiser description.

records.text: American Cancer Society fundraising through the Cattle Barons Ball was a money-laundering operation used to pay off corrupt police officers.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep 9naMwS0kMBE)

appearances.snippet: we were speaking about the American Cancer Society, which seems the person who gave me that tip about Dan Flood and said that he ran with these people said that money is being funneled, that it's just a money laundering operation to pay off dirty cops through ... the Cattlemen's Ball, Cattle Barons Ball

verification.notes: Official Cattle Barons Ball materials describe fundraising for the American Cancer Society and cancer research, but no audited financial record, court filing, or law-enforcement source found in current searches substantiates money laundering or payments to corrupt officers.
